rows.claim: Switching the precedence will break ops' reliance on file-over-env, if they rely on it.
rows.evidence: The claim is conditional: if ops relies on file-over-env, switching precedence breaks it. The test test_file_pins_override_env (T0B5) has a comment saying ops pins values in the file so env vars can't change them, and it fails after the change (T0B7: assert '9000' == 8080). This shows the behavior change would break that pinning. Whether ops actually relies on it is not claimed as fact.
